paragraphs.en: If you use the GitHub CLI (v2.90.0+), you can install skills with gh skill :
paragraphs.zh: 如果您使用 GitHub CLI（v2.90.0 及以上版本），可以使用 gh skill 安装技能：

paragraphs.en: # Browse and install interactively gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills # Install a specific skill directly gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills scanpy # Target a specific agent host gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills --agent cursor gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills --agent claude-code gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills --agent codex gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills --agent gemini gh skill automatically installs to the correct directory for your agent host and records provenance metadata for supply chain integrity.
paragraphs.zh:
# 浏览并交互式安装
gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills

# 直接安装某个特定技能
gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills scanpy

# 面向特定的智能体宿主
gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills --agent cursor
gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills --agent claude-code
gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills --agent codex
gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills --agent gemini

gh skill 会自动安装到你的智能体宿主的正确目录，并记录来源（provenance）元数据以保障供应链完整性。

paragraphs.en: Pin to a specific release tag or commit SHA for reproducible installs:

paragraphs.en: # Pin to a release tag gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills --pin v2.71.0 # Pin to a commit SHA gh skill install K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills --pin abc123def Keeping skills up to date # Check for updates interactively gh skill update # Update all installed skills gh skill update --all Option 3: Agent Plugins (Cursor, Codex, and other plugin clients) This repository is a valid Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package: root plugin.json plus Agent Skills under skills/ . Clients that support the standard discover every immediate child of skills/ that contains a SKILL.md .

paragraphs.en: We take security seriously. All contributions go through a review process, and we run LLM-based security scans (via Cisco AI Defense Skill Scanner ) on every skill in this repository. However, as a small team with a growing number of community contributions, we cannot guarantee that every skill has been exhaustively reviewed for all possible risks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们非常重视安全性。 所有贡献都会经过审核流程，并且我们会使用基于 LLM 的安全扫描（通过 Cisco AI Defense Skill Scanner）对仓库中的每个技能进行扫描。 然而，作为一个社区贡献数量不断增长的小团队，我们无法保证每个技能都已经过针对所有可能风险的详尽审查。

paragraphs.en: uv pip install cisco-ai-skill-scanner skill-scanner scan /path/to/skill --use-behavioral Report anything suspicious. If you find a skill that looks malicious or behaves unexpectedly, please open an issue immediately so we can investigate. Skills are scanned weekly — incrementally, so unchanged skills carry their previous findings forward, with a full rescan of everything at least every 30 days and whenever the scanner or model changes — and the results are published to docs/security-report.md . See SECURITY.md for our security policy, what is in scope, how to report a vulnerability privately, and how to contest a scan finding. We try to address security gaps as they arise.

paragraphs.en: # Install repository development and validation tools uv sync # Structural contract and coverage guard — seconds, no scientific packages needed uv run python -m pytest tests/_meta -q # Validate one skill's Agent Skills frontmatter uv run skills-ref validate skills/ < skill-name > # One skill's suite in the current environment uv run --with pytest python -m pytest tests/ < skill-name > -q # One skill with its declared packages and Python version uv run python tests/run_all.py --isolated < skill-name > # Every suite, each in its own throwaway environment uv run python tests/run_all.py --isolated Run one skill per pytest process: different skills reuse module names such as _common , so collecting several suites together can import the wrong module. tests/run_all.py handles process isolation; --isolated also provides each skill's declared dependency environment. A suite run in the current environment may skip checks when required packages are absent.
paragraphs.zh: # 安装仓库开发和验证工具 uv sync # 结构契约与覆盖率守卫——只需几秒，无需科学计算包 uv run python -m pytest tests/_meta -q # 校验某个技能的 Agent Skills frontmatter uv run skills-ref validate skills/<skill-name> # 在当前环境中运行某个技能的测试套件 uv run --with pytest python -m pytest tests/<skill-name> -q # 使用该技能声明的包和 Python 版本运行 uv run python tests/run_all.py --isolated <skill-name> # 运行所有套件，每个套件各自使用独立的一次性环境 uv run python tests/run_all.py --isolated 每个 pytest 进程只运行一个技能：不同技能会重用诸如 _common 这样的模块名，因此将多个套件一起收集时可能导入错误的模块。tests/run_all.py 会处理进程隔离；--isolated 还会为每个技能提供其声明的依赖环境。 在当前环境中运行的测试套件，在缺少所需包时可能会跳过部分检查。

paragraphs.en: All skills in this repository are security-scanned using Cisco AI Defense Skill Scanner , an open-source tool that detects prompt injection, data exfiltration, and malicious code patterns in Agent Skills.
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库中的所有技能均使用 Cisco AI Defense Skill Scanner 进行安全扫描，这是一款开源工具，可检测智能体技能（Agent Skills）中的提示词注入、数据外泄和恶意代码模式。

paragraphs.en: If you are contributing a new skill, we recommend running the scanner locally before submitting a pull request:
paragraphs.zh: 如果你要贡献新的技能（skill），我们建议在提交拉取请求（pull request）之前先在本地运行扫描器：

paragraphs.en: uv pip install cisco-ai-skill-scanner skill-scanner scan /path/to/your/skill --use-behavioral Note: A clean scan result reduces noise in review, but does not guarantee a skill is free of all risk. Contributed skills are also reviewed manually before merging.
paragraphs.zh: uv pip install cisco-ai-skill-scanner skill-scanner scan /path/to/your/skill --use-behavioral 注意：干净的扫描结果可以减少审查中的噪音，但不能保证技能完全没有风险。 贡献的技能在合并前也会进行人工审查。

paragraphs.en: Q: Why are all skills grouped together instead of separate packages? A: We believe good science in the age of AI is inherently interdisciplinary. Bundling all skills together makes it trivial for you (and your agent) to bridge across fields—e.g., combining genomics, cheminformatics, clinical data, and machine learning in one workflow—without worrying about which individual skills to install or wire together.
paragraphs.zh: 问：为什么所有技能都打包在一起，而不是分成独立的包？ 答：我们相信，在 AI 时代，优秀的科学本质上是跨学科的。 将所有技能打包在一起，让你（和你的智能体）可以轻松跨越不同领域——例如，在一个工作流中结合基因组学、化学信息学、临床数据和机器学习——而无需操心该安装哪些技能或如何将它们连接起来。
